response.message:
your list is already stacked on the tokyo end, so i'll fill in [kyoto](kebi://area/jp/kyoto) and osaka and then build on what you've saved for the final stretch.

---

kyoto (nothing saved here yet, so this one's on me)

[Arashiyama Bamboo Forest](kebi://venue/f4b47463-0468-4adb-95a6-71f8a4b65393) is the one to anchor a morning around, go early, the crowds thin out fast and the light through the bamboo before 8am is the version you've seen all over tiktok but better in person. Nijo Castle is the historical weight of the trip, a UNESCO site with the famous "nightingale floors" that squeak as you walk to deter assassins, genuinely interesting, not just a pretty exterior. [Nishiki Market](kebi://venue/4137a972-fe01-4266-bbaf-3fb145d70659) is the afternoon move, a covered street market in the city center where you graze stall to stall. and Kyoto Tower gives you the city overview if you want to get your bearings from above.

kyoto rewards slow mornings, don't try to cram it.

---

osaka (nothing saved here yet either, still on me)

[Dotonbori](kebi://venue/1b247b82-0663-4f4f-be22-875f5ccc0a9f) is the obvious anchor, the neon canal strip, street food everywhere, takoyaki and okonomiyaki on every corner, genuinely fun at night. pair it with [Kuromon Market](kebi://venue/e35b0bea-bc55-4afb-adb5-a9cb8391e1b1) for daytime eating, that's the local food market where you graze stall to stall. [Osaka Castle](kebi://venue/15a9d47a-0fb6-44ec-89ac-e7fb01492588) is worth a half morning, the park around it is as good as the castle itself. and if you're into retro culture and electronics, [Nipponbashi](kebi://venue/4674c8b7-cf21-4b08-b0b1-2ab831ba2200) (Den Den Town) is right nearby.

osaka is the eat-everything city of the three, lean into that.

---

tokyo (your saves take over here)

you've got [teamLab Planets](kebi://venue/3546d397-b212-4cb4-866a-3a87cd06c485), [Meiji Jingu](kebi://venue/d4104468-7ac7-4674-8b91-a9b1b559fcfb), [Shibuya Sky](kebi://venue/1bd47f5c-8855-4ba9-98e6-d4c6ccf6427f), and [Shinjuku Gyoen](kebi://venue/1cf8682b-9ba4-4cc1-8a07-651c8b8b7b37) all saved, that's already a strong spread. a few thoughts on ordering them:

- teamLab Planets is an evening move, book ahead, it sells out
- Shibuya Sky is best around sunset, same deal on booking
- Meiji Jingu pairs naturally with Shinjuku Gyoen since they're both on the western side of the city, do them together on one calm morning
- [Universal Studios Japan](kebi://venue/e68f1787-c5f6-4ed6-81b1-e0296a02ecf9) is also in your saves, but that's technically osaka, so slot it into your osaka days if you want it

---

on the way, [Mount Fuji](kebi://venue/67543868-5745-45bd-a5e9-4ab948480e30) is in your saves and it sits between the kansai region and tokyo. best approached from the tokyo side, either as a day trip or an overnight at Kawaguchiko. worth knowing before you lock the order of stops.

how many nights are you splitting across each city? that changes how much i'd pack into each stop.
